Halo 1.desc: SAW carried from Halo 4, built with its own numbers. The suggested balance measures it against the Assault Rifle, which both games have.
The Elites' energy sword, made pickable: Halo 3's first-person animations and sounds, Halo 1's own sword. Fire lunges (costs energy), melee slashes.
Halo 1.balance_desc: One lunge kills an Elite (420 damage), 20 lunges per charge, stronger lunge aim assist (15 deg / 3.5 wu, 15 deg / 8 wu) and a wider lunge hit.

Halo 1.desc: The Grunts' fuel rod, made pickable: Halo 3's first-person animations and sounds on the original gun. Hold fire to charge; it fires when full.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Instant fire at 2.5 rods/s and it hurts Hunters (the Grunts' fuel rods too; they fire two rods per burst instead of one).
requires: proj weapons\fuel rod gun\grunt fuel rod

tag_map.proj weapons\\rocket launcher\\rocket: proj weapons\fuel rod gun\grunt fuel rod

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Sentinel Beam: its model, first-person animations and sounds. Dropped by Sentinels when they die. A continuous beam on heat and battery.
Halo 1.balance_desc: 11.6 damage per round instead of 4.64, Halo 1-style aim assist (1 deg / 25 wu autoaim, 12 deg / 25 wu magnetism) and Halo 3's battery: 11 s of fire instead of 5.6 s.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's SMG: its model, first-person animations, sounds and numbers. A 60-round automatic; Assault Rifle ammo tops it up.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Assault Rifle, which both games have: 6.67 damage per round (Halo 1 fires it at 15 rounds/s), a 112 magazine, 450 at pickup / 562 most, a 2.5 s reload, a wider spray in long bursts, a faster bullet and Halo 1-style aim assist.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Battle Rifle: its model, first-person animations, sounds and numbers. A 36-round, 3-round-burst rifle with a 2x zoom; Pistol ammo tops it up.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Pistol, which both games have: 10 damage per round (30 a burst), a 54 magazine, 202 at pickup / 360 most, a 2.6 s reload, a tighter spread, a faster bullet and Halo 1-style aim assist.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Covenant Carbine: its model, first-person animations, sounds, scope and numbers. An 18-round semi-automatic rifle with a 2x zoom; Pistol ammo tops it up.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Pistol, which both games have: 16.7 damage per round, up to 8.2 rounds a second, a 27 magazine, 101 at pickup / 225 most, a 3.1 s reload, a wider spread when held, a faster slug and Halo 1-style aim assist.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Beam Rifle: its model, first-person animations, sounds, scope and numbers. A Covenant marksman rifle on heat and battery: two quick shots overheat it, 20 shots a battery, 3.5x / 9.5x zoom.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Sniper Rifle, which both games have: 101 damage per shot, up to 3.5 shots a second, Halo 1's 2x / 8x-style zoom (1.75x / 8.4x), a longer reach and Halo 1-style aim assist; heat and battery stay Halo 3's.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Spike Rifle: its model, first-person animations, sounds and numbers. A 40-round Brute automatic firing slow, arcing spikes that ricochet off metal and rock, with a blade for melee; Assault Rifle ammo tops it up.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Assault Rifle, which both games have: 12 damage per spike at 12 a second, a 75 magazine, 300 at pickup / 375 most, a 2.8 s reload, a wider spray, faster spikes and Halo 1-style aim assist; the arc and the ricochet stay Halo 3's.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Mauler: its model, first-person animations, sounds and numbers. A one-handed 5-round Brute shotgun firing 15 pellets that lose most of their damage past a few metres, with a blade for melee.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Shotgun, which both games have: 15 pellets of 12.6-17.5 damage (4 at range, over 1.9-3.8 m), a 10-round magazine, 13 at pickup / 62 most, a wider cone, Halo 1-style pellet speed and range, and Halo 1-style aim assist.

Halo 1.desc: Halo 3's Brute Shot: its model, first-person animations, sounds and numbers. A 6-round Brute grenade launcher firing arcing grenades that explode on impact, with a blade for melee.
Halo 1.balance_desc: Measured against the Rocket Launcher, which both games have: 91-100 damage per grenade over 1.1 m, one shot every 0.75 s, a 3.4 s reload, faster grenades with a shorter reach, a heavier blade, and Halo 1-style aim assist.

the ammo readout turns red at the same quarter-magazine Halo 3 uses everywhere: 8 of 32 on the Assault Rifle, 18 of 72 here (and 18 of 60 on the SMG). Same either way, because the port's magazine is 72 balanced or not.

0xE128 is one of only two unclaimed weapon-shaped glyphs in the shared Halo 3 / ODST icon font. NOTE: this field does NOT draw the pickup prompt -- proved by setting it to the gravity hammer's 0xE120 and seeing no change in game. It is kept because it is the weapon's own icon codepoint and the donor's would be wrong, but the prompt icon comes from somewhere else: most likely the chud's Sequence Index into ui\chud itmaps\weapon_scematics, which the port inherited from the Assault Rifle along with its chud.
